novelty.justification: The novelty route is a mechanism/measurement hypothesis: the claim proposes that an LLM's “operative belief” and “avowed belief” are “encoded along partially separable directions that can dissociate,” and that self-report errors arise from decoupling between those pathways. Searches using “LLM operative belief avowed belief,” “language model internal belief versus self-report,” “LLM introspection predict own behavior,” and “activation steering honest self-report” identify Looking Inward: Language Models Can Learn About Themselves by Introspection (2024), Spilling the Beans: Teaching LLMs to Self-Report Their Hidden Objectives (2025), and Brittle Minds, Fixable Activations (2024) as the closest work, but none establishes this matched task-governing-versus-introspective subspace relationship. The step is a substantive natural extension combining behavioral introspection, belief probing, and activation steering into a new unit of analysis—the operative–avowed gap—rather than a wholly new interpretability paradigm, supporting standard rather than high novelty.
